# Case-insensitive terms that must not appear in a commit message, a pull
# request title, or a pull request description. Checked by
# .github/workflows/tool-attribution-check.yml, which looks only at the
# commits new to a pull request and at that pull request's own title and
# body, never at history already on main.

# This file is the single place to add or remove a term; the check script
# (.github/scripts/check_tool_attribution.py) reads it and does not keep
# its own copy of the list.
